test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three positions of the same dice are given. What will be the digit on the face opposite to the face having the digit 3?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/548136d59318d779d3ef1906bd17d54c8a24120148fe68c5642b1b0b611b5252.png]
solution:
When we observe the given figures we can see that:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef0e27f98350b6c116c5d9c243d3e91cfa2b1e9b3d100c080e51eed167eabad.png] 

The face 2 and 4 have 3 on their left and 6 on their right and if we make two faces fixed the left and right of those faces are opposite which means **face 3 and 6 are opposite to each other. **

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
